objective: Official possession spellF1 averaged equally across two external development matches and original/degraded scenarios
training: No new classifier fitting. Frozen v1 and v2 team evidence; tune only sequence parameters on the two development matches. These are calibration scores, not independent validation.
source: IDSSE Figshare 28196177 version 1; CC BY 4.0; observed x/y input only; separate explicit external H/A/D references
degradation: Same fixed faults and seeds as previous experiments: 43 percent ball block gaps, 15 percent individual player dropout, 1 percent ball jumps; seed 20261114+sum(ord(match))*10+segment
context: Blend learned and legacy home log-odds. Learned weight is multiplied by q+(1-q)*missing_multiplier, where q is centred 0.8s mean of frozen v1 ball reliability. Symmetric for home/away.
dead_head: Frozen v1, unchanged. No new dead gaps or labels inferred from ball absence. No reference restart anchor in inference.
coarse_search: Unique grid (skip duplicate missing multipliers when learned_weight=0); evaluate every fifth frame, 5Hz. Select top eight admissible configurations plus exact frozen v1 for full 25Hz development refinement.
guards: Every match/scenario: macroF1 >= v1-0.015, spellF1 >= v1-0.015. At full 25Hz, additionally require correct H/A/D on missing-ball restart-offset samples >= v1-0.02 when eligible. Unknown references masked. Halves and gaps remain separate runs.
tie_break: Highest equal-match/scenario mean spellF1; ties prefer exact v1, then lower learned weight, missing_multiplier=0, smaller penalty, less smoothing, continuous decoding
freeze: Save selected parameters, all coarse/full development results, evidence code hash, official metric source hash, and frozen dependency hashes before any fresh scoring
fresh_gate: Mean scenario spellF1 improves >=0.02 vs v1; no scenario spellF1 worse than v1-0.01; macroF1 no worse than v1-0.015 each scenario; missing-ball restart-offset accuracy no worse than v1-0.02 when eligible. Also report v2a without selecting an ablation after seeing validation.
fresh_metrics: Official spellF1 IoUs 0.3..0.7, possession counts/durations, 1000-draw possession bootstrap; macroF1; frame accuracy; missing-ball restart offsets 0.5,1,2s; boundary-safe per-half evaluation. One fresh match is not proof of challenge transfer.
tagging: Frozen 1.2 Smart Tagging home log-odds in both team heads, zero externally. No challenge label/video/public-score tuning.
attribution: Bassek, Rein, Weber & Memmert (2025); DFL / Sportec Solutions; IDSSE DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28196177.v1; CC BY 4.0
